verdict.rationale: The SDK documents automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation for function tools, plus optional structured outputs on agents. That gives schema validation, but the evidence frames it as runtime validation of tool arguments and outputs, not build-time error catching. Guardrails (input/output checks) are also runtime only. Missing for 10: evidence of static typing support (type hints/stubs, mypy/pyright or TypeScript type checking) that surfaces errors at build time, documentation of strict-mode schema enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
